text:
Predicates:
SupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is a supervised learning algorithm.
UnsupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is an unsupervised learning algorithm.
ReinforcementLearning(x) ::: x is a reinforcement learning algorithm.
RequireLabelledData(x) ::: x requires labelled data.
TrainedWith(x, y) ::: x is trained with y.
StateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel(x) ::: x is the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
Question1(x) ::: Unsupervised learning is used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
Premises:
SupervisedLearning(x) ∨ UnsupervisedLearning(x) ∨ ReinforcementLearning(x) ::: Machine Learning algorithms can be categorized as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning.
UnsupervisedLearning(x) → ¬RequireLabelledData(x) ::: Unsupervised learning doesn't require labelled data.
TrainedWith(StateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel, y) ∧ MachineLearningAlgorithm(y) ::: The state-of-the-art text summarization model is trained with machine learning algorithms.
¬ReinforcementLearning(x) → ¬TrainedWith(StateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel, x) ::: Reinforcement learning is not used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
RequireLabelledData(x) → MachineLearningAlgorithm(x) ::: The Machine Learning algorithm for training text summarization model requires labelled data.
Conclusion:
¬Question1(UnsupervisedLearning)
